doc_friction.issue: The 'already-swept audits' list is long; differential testing against a real oracle (sshd, git, editorconfig, node-semver) is now a well-worn explore pattern too, and listing those already done would have saved ~10 minutes of checking gitignore/semver/editorconfig before finding a gap.

unwired_checks.py is mentioned only through run_venture_tests' trailing note; it caught two real issues (CSV formula guard, fragile CLI entry guard) that the venture suite did not, so a new-venture checklist should name it.

writeups: ventures/npm-publish-contents/README.md (method and verification; no separate docs/reports agent doc: the README carries what the next run needs)
notes: Explore idea: npm publish contents explainer (ventures/npm-publish-contents). Reimplements npm-packlist + ignore-walk + minimatch over a virtual tree; per-file deciding rule; secrets, shadowed .gitignore, missing entry points. Held-out differential 3000/3000 vs npm 10.9.9 and 3000/3000 vs npm 11.21.3 (npm@11 installed in scratch); minimatch grid 5304/5304; 338 installed packages and 22 repo source trees (npm pack --verify) agree. Found and verified on both npm majors: main written './x' is not force-packed; a '!' rule inside an ignored folder makes npm enter it and ship the whole folder. Local checks: venture suites 3 pass, unwired_checks 279/279 (after fixing CSV guard + CLI entry guard), siblings 20/20 after adding reciprocal links, check_posts ok, run_workflow_locally --for-changes: all run steps passed except sibling-links, fixed after the run started and re-verified with siblings.test.mjs.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: senior JS dev reimplementing npm-packlist/minimatch with a differential harness, page, CLI and guide

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
